primary_source: HQ Department of the Army FM 3-97.61 Military Mountaineering (Aug 2002, approved for public release); access copy https://archive.org/download/MManuals/Fm3-97UsArmyMilitaryMountaineering2002.pdf (SHA-256 62ec8d80a2f5d8d90a60eb879890f4d2c62d155c1ac7c2effa3a5fef204dcb48)
exact_locator: Chapter 4 Section III, para 4-12 Bowline, tying steps and checkpoints, pages 4-13 to 4-14 (PDF pages 112-113)
bounded_scope: A bowline ties a single fixed loop in a rope end; the bight is locked into place by a loop; the short portion of the bight is inside the fixed loop; a minimum 4-inch pigtail remains after the overhand safety.
limitations: Mountaineering rope and trained users; no utility-cord rating; superseded edition (TC 3-97.61, July 2012, not retrieved: official and mirror copies were gated). Physical tying not verified.
follow_up: Confirm TC 3-97.61 wording; rigging specialist topology review.

primary_source: FM 3-97.61 (Aug 2002), same access copy and hash as W2C-E001
exact_locator: Para 4-14 Figure-eight retrace, figure-eight knot description, page 4-15 (PDF page 114); para 4-20 Figure-eight loop, steps and checkpoints, pages 4-21 to 4-22 (PDF pages 120-121)
bounded_scope: A figure-eight knot is made by forming a loop, wrapping the working end around the standing part and routing it through the loop; the figure-eight loop forms a fixed loop whose ropes run parallel without crossing, tightly dressed.
limitations: No statement on grommet size or pull-through; the stopper use at a grommet remains editorial. Superseded edition.
follow_up: Confirm TC 3-97.61 wording; rigging specialist review.

primary_source: USGS, How To Get Your Map and Compass To Face the Same Direction, https://www.usgs.gov/educational-resources/how-get-your-map-and-compass-face-same-direction
exact_locator: Orientation steps (baseplate on the north-south neat line; dial to map north; declination correction; turn together until the red needle overlays the orienting arrow; compare features)
bounded_scope: Procedure for orienting a paper map to true north with a baseplate compass, including the sign of the declination correction and the adjustable-compass exception.
limitations: Undated page; declination values come from a current model or map margin; grid north not addressed.

bounded_scope: Replacement support identified in FM 3-97.61 paras 4-1 to 4-3 (pages 4-1 to 4-3): sharp edges cut nylon rope under tension; leaving rope knotted or tightly stretched reduces strength and life over time; ultraviolet light deteriorates nylon; inspect before and after each use; select rope by task, type, diameter and tensile strength.
limitations: No support found for the wet-fiber strength-loss part of K09. FM context is mountaineering rope, not camp cord.
